title: confiture validate-profile --format json
description: The shape of an anonymization profile that validated: its strategies and, per table, which strategy each column gets. Never a seed: the payload says whether one is set, and a strategy's seed_env_var names a variable, not its value. A profile that is missing or invalid writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead — CONFIG_004 for the path, ANON_1400 for the content.

valid.description: Always true in this shape: an invalid profile writes the error envelope.

path.description: The profile file, as given on the command line.

has_global_seed.description: True when the profile sets `global_seed`; the seed itself is never written.

strategies.description: Each strategy the profile defines, by name.

type.description: The strategy type, one of the whitelisted types (`hash`, `email`, `phone`, `redact`, …).

seed_env_var.description: The environment variable the strategy reads its seed from — its name, never its value; null when it names none.

tables.description: Each table the profile anonymizes, by name, with its rules in file order.

strategy.description: The name of a strategy under `strategies`.

has_seed.description: True when the rule sets its own `seed`; the seed itself is never written.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
